quantity: volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model
reference: DAMIT model 1834 calibrated size, Hanuš et al. (2017), A&A 601, A114
notes: DAMIT marks model 1834 as size-calibrated (D = 125 km, σ = 3 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 125 ± 3 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 47 light curves, 1 adaptive-optics image and 1 occultation (Table 3). Both pole solutions reproduce the adaptive-optics and occultation data; the paper says the second pole (this model) "might be preferred" but does not reject the first.
